37: What are we preparing for you?
45: We need to know as much as possible about your level and what you want to learn at our MTB school. At our first meeting we will agree on the form of coaching that suits you best and find out which areas of your riding technique you want to improve. You will need your beloved bike and safety gear (helmet, gloves, sturdy shoes). Ideally come without SPD pedals – we can lend you ours if agreed in advance. Bring your own food and drinks (does not apply to camps).
47: For individual courses and camps we use the beautiful leisure park in Tehov, which we built together with the municipality – it has a technical trail, a pump track and Trial features. We can also travel to bike parks or trails anywhere in the Czech Republic. We adapt to your schedule, and the total lesson time is planned according to what we will practise. There are also many beautiful natural spots nearby with different surfaces and levels of technical difficulty.
49: Everyone improves at their own pace, and the aim of the Bikeskills project is to find your limits, set the right approach and – through advice and demonstration – help you make as much progress as possible. From balance and trails to riding difficult terrain and jumps, we will be your guides to improving or understanding the basics. Photos and video of your achievements can also be arranged on request. We love following our students' progress in their biking life.{1}{2}
